question: Approve the in-flow banner design for implementation?

artifacts.summary: Approach: fixed overlay → in-flow .u-banner under the control bar (calm) / above hero tiles (regular); consent wiring and disclosure text unchanged (AC-3/AC-4). Rejected alternative named with reason (restyle-in-place still occludes). Mock (mock.html) rendered and FO-verified: banner + product both visible on first paint. ACs carry external Verified-by clauses with falsifying edits. Risk: none material — pure presentation change on a proven surface; no spike needed, handler + localStorage paths unchanged.
